violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The dishwasher failed to wash his/her hands between loading soiled and unloading clean dishes from the dishwasher. Food employees must clean their hands after handling soiled equipment or utensils. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by a rolling rack. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. A strainer was observed in the hand-washing sink at the main bar, and employee was observed rinsing cups in the same sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the bar. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking proper signage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Open containers of food observed inside the freezer. Food must be protected from contamination by packaging, covered containers, or wrapping. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. The empty chlorine container was changed. Recommend keeping daily sanitizer logs. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Chicken in 3 bay sink was observed at 56 degrees F. Hamburgers, ham, and chili in small prep unit (held since 11 a.m.) observed held at 47-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees i Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were placed in walk in, and will be kept on ice in unit during hot weather. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods (burgers) on the menu that are raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Food observed stored on the floor in the walk in cooler and walk in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor.Dunnage racks are recommended. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Raw chicken was observed directly in the 3 bay sink, with the center sink filled with dirty water.Chicken was removed from sink.Colandars are to be used in sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Knives observed stored in the crack between prep units in the pizza area.Utensils must be stored in a clean area. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Single-use items are being reused for food prep and storage.Single-use items shall not be reused. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the storage area. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
The pizza crust roller was not in good repair, with some of the points broken off. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the beer coolers at barstable inside walk in coolercan opener basetop of water heater near ice machineice machinecart in pizza prep area have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/02/2026
Coving in the main bar is in poor repair, pulling away from the wall. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

The floor and wall junctures beneath the 3 bay sink in the kitchen do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch.The floor and wall junctures in the ( ) do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of use to be professionally serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice bins at large bar, and dough hook) were observed with an accumulation of water and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice bins are to be cleaned & sanitized before use. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2024

Utensils were observed stored on unclean walls. Cleaned equipment and utensils must be stored in a clean location, where they are not subject to dust, splash, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024
Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024
The large mixing bowl was not in good repair, with dents impacting its ability to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2024
The gasket on the door of the tall freezer was not in good repair (torn). New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: floor mixer underside of kitchen shelves counters near the poles for the shelves broiler lids and container at grill New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024

The ceiling, ceiling light cover, and fan covers have an accumulation of dust, mold, and debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2024
One light beneath the hood was nonfunctional during inspection. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2024
Ceiling light covers in the kitchen are in poor repair, cracked with pieces missing. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2024
